title: Add optional login, notifications, and download features

requirements.text: Implement optional Internet Identity login system that allows users to browse all content without logging in, but enables notifications when logged in

quotes: Optional login with Internet Identity - log in karne walon ko in-app notifications milenge
bina login ke bhi sab browse kar sakte hain

acceptanceCriteria: Users can view all poetry content without logging in
Login button is visible in header for unauthenticated users
Logged-in users see their authentication status in header
All existing browsing functionality (collections, search, poem viewing) works without authentication

requirements.text: Add in-app notification system that displays alerts to logged-in users when new poetry is added to the platform

quotes: jab nayi poetry add hogi toh logged-in users ko website par notification dikhega (free feature)
Jab nayi poetry add ho toh logged-in users ko notification dikhega

acceptanceCriteria: Backend tracks when new poems are added with timestamps
Backend provides endpoint to fetch notifications for logged-in users
Frontend displays notification badge or icon when new poetry is available
Notifications are only visible to authenticated users
Users can view and clear their notifications

requirements.text: Add download button for image-type poems that enables direct image file download

quotes: Image wali poetry: Direct image download

acceptanceCriteria: Download button appears on poem detail page for image-type poems
Clicking download button triggers browser download of the poem image
Downloaded file has appropriate filename based on poem title or ID
Download works for all existing image poems

requirements.text: Add download button for text-type poems that converts the text content into an image format (poster/card style) and downloads it

quotes: Text wali poetry: Text ko image format mein convert karke download (beautiful card/poster ki tarah)
text poetry ko beautiful image format mein convert karke download

acceptanceCriteria: Download button appears on poem detail page for text-type poems
Text content is rendered into an attractive image format with appropriate styling
Generated image includes poem text, author name, and branding
Clicking download button triggers browser download of the generated image
Image format maintains readability and visual appeal

requirements.text: Update website title and branding from 'International Gojri Maa Booli Adab' to 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab' in both the browser tab title and header display

quotes: naam mai thoda change karo international gojri maa boli adab
Naam Update - 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab' dono jagah (website title aur browser tab)

acceptanceCriteria: Browser tab title displays 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab'
Header component displays 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab'
Spelling change from 'Booli' to 'Boli' is applied consistently across all branding locations

constraints: All existing features (poetry submission, collections management, search functionality) must remain intact and functional
Login system must use Internet Identity as the authentication provider
Notification system must be free (no paid third-party services)
Users must be able to browse all content without requiring login
nonGoals: User profiles or social features beyond basic authentication
Editing or deleting existing poems through the public interface
